# appsignal_log_metric (Resource)

A log metrics action in an AppSignal app: it turns matching lines into counter, gauge or distribution metrics. Log actions run in order and new ones are added last; see appsignal_log_action_order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appsignal_log_metric" "jobs" {
  app_id     = appsignal_app.web.id
  name       = "Job metrics"
  query      = "message:job_finished"
  drop_lines = true
  metrics = [
    { name = "jobs.finished", type = "counter", tags = { queue = "default" } },
    { name = "jobs.duration", type = "distribution", field = "duration_ms" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String)
- `metrics` (Attributes List) Metrics taken from each matching line. Metric names must be unique within the app. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metrics))
- `name` (String)
- `query` (String) Log query selecting the lines. AppSignal does not validate it, so check it in the log viewer first.

### Optional

- `drop_lines` (Boolean) Drop the matching lines once the metrics are taken from them. AppSignal does this with a filter of its own right after this action. Defaults to false.
- `source_ids` (Set of String) Log sources the action applies to. Empty means every source of the app.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metrics`

Required:

- `name` (String) Lowercase letters, digits, dots and underscores.
- `type` (String) One of counter, gauge, distribution.

Optional:

- `field` (String) Line attribute holding the value. Required for gauge and distribution metrics.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags added to the metric.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import appsignal_log_metric.jobs <app_id>/<log_action_id>
```
